def quality_check_content(content):
    if not content or len(content.strip()) < 200:
        return False
    quality_indicators = 0
    if "```
        quality_indicators += 2
    if "###" in content or "##" in content or "\n# " in content:
        quality_indicators += 1
    if len(re.findall(r"\b[A-ZÁÉÍÓÖŐÚÜŰ][a-záéíóöőúüű]+\b", content)) > 50:
        quality_indicators += 1
    if re.search(r"\$\$[\s\S]+?\$\$", content):
        quality_indicators += 2
    if any(token in content.lower() for token in ["bevezetés", "összefoglalás", "következtetés", "definíció"]):
        quality_indicators += 1
    return quality_indicators >= 4


def download_and_process_pdf(pdf_url):
    with pdf_lock:
        if pdf_url in visited_pdfs:
            return None
        visited_pdfs.add(pdf_url)
    print(f"\n[PDF DOWNLOAD] {pdf_url}")
    client_idx = get_client()
    try:
        response = requests.get(
            pdf_url,
            timeout=60,
            headers={
                "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
            }
        )
        if response.status_code != 200:
            return None
        pdf_file = io.BytesIO(response.content)
        pdf_reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(pdf_file)
        pdf_text = ""
        max_pages = min(len(pdf_reader.pages), 99)
        for page_num in range(max_pages):
            try:
                page = pdf_reader.pages[page_num]
                text = page.extract_text()
                if text:
                    pdf_text += text + "\n\n"
            except Exception:
                continue
        if len(pdf_text.strip()) <= 500:
            return None
        cleaned = process_with_ultra_quality_ai(pdf_url, pdf_text, "pdf", client_idx)
        if not cleaned or not quality_check_content(cleaned):
            return None
        content_hash = calculate_content_hash(cleaned)
        with hash_lock:
            if content_hash in content_hashes:
                return None
            content_hashes.add(content_hash)
        entry = {
            "text": cleaned,
            "meta": {
                "source": pdf_url,
                "type": "scientific_paper",
                "format": "pdf",
                "language": "hu",
                "quality_score": 0.95,
                "timestamp": int(time.time()),
                "estimated_tokens": estimate_tokens(cleaned)
            }
        }
        return entry

            stats["processing_errors"] += 1
        return None

        return_client(client_idx)


def get_all_links(url, base_domain):
    try:
        response = requests.get(
            url,
            timeout=3,
            headers={
                "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
            }
        )
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")
        links = set()
        pdf_links = set()
        for link in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
            href = link.get("href")
            full_url = urljoin(url, href)
            parsed = urlparse(full_url)
            if parsed.netloc == base_domain and not parsed.fragment:
                clean_url = f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}{parsed.path}"
                if parsed.query:
                    clean_url += f"?{parsed.query}"
                if clean_url.endswith(".pdf"):
                    pdf_links.add(clean_url)
                else:
                    links.add(clean_url)
        return links, pdf_links
    except Exception as e:
        print(f" Error getting links from {url}: {e}")
        return set(), set()


def crawl_page(url, base_domain):
    with url_lock:
        if url in visited_urls:
            return None
        visited_urls.add(url)
        current_count = len(visited_urls)
    print(f"\n[{current_count}] Processing: {url}")
    client_idx = get_client()
    try:
        response = requests.get(
            url,
            timeout=3,
            headers={
                "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
            }
        )
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")
        metadata = extract_metadata(soup, url)
        for tag in soup(["script", "style", "noscript"]):
            tag.decompose()
        html_text = str(soup)
        cleaned = process_with_ultra_quality_ai(url, html_text, "html", client_idx, metadata)
        if cleaned and quality_check_content(cleaned):
            content_hash = calculate_content_hash(cleaned)
            with hash_lock:
                if content_hash in content_hashes:
                    return None
                content_hashes.add(content_hash)
            entry = {
                "text": cleaned,
                "meta": {
                    "source": url,
                    "type": "documentation",
                    "format": "html",
                    "language": "hu",
                    "quality_score": 0.92,
                    "timestamp": int(time.time()),
                    "estimated_tokens": estimate_tokens(cleaned),
                    "title": metadata.get("title", ""),
                    "authors": metadata.get("authors", []),
                    "categories": metadata.get("categories", [])
                }
            }
            with output_lock:
                with open(output_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    f.write(json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                stats["total_entries"] += 1
                stats["html_pages"] += 1
                stats["total_tokens_estimate"] += entry["meta"]["estimated_tokens"]
                with open(stats_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    json.dump(stats, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
                print(f" Saved! Total: {stats['total_entries']} entries, ~{stats['total_tokens_estimate']:,} tokens")
            return entry
        return None
    except Exception as e:
        print(f" Error: {e}")
        with output_lock:
            stats["processing_errors"] += 1
        return None
    finally:
        return_client(client_idx)


def worker_thread(url_queue, pdf_queue, base_domain, max_pages):
    while True:
        try:
            url = url_queue.get(timeout=3)
            with url_lock:
                if len(visited_urls) >= max_pages:
                    url_queue.task_done()
                    break
            crawl_page(url, base_domain)
            new_links, new_pdfs = get_all_links(url, base_domain)
            for link in new_links:
                with url_lock:
                    if link not in visited_urls and len(visited_urls) < max_pages:
                        url_queue.put(link)
            for pdf_link in new_pdfs:
                with pdf_lock:
                    if pdf_link not in visited_pdfs:
                        pdf_queue.put(pdf_link)
            url_queue.task_done()
        except queue.Empty:
            break
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Worker error: {e}")
            url_queue.task_done()


def pdf_worker_thread(pdf_queue):
    while True:
        try:
            pdf_url = pdf_queue.get(timeout=3)
            pdf_entry = download_and_process_pdf(pdf_url)
            if pdf_entry:
                with output_lock:
                    with open(output_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        f.write(json.dumps(pdf_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                    stats["total_entries"] += 1
                    stats["pdfs"] += 1
                    stats["total_tokens_estimate"] += pdf_entry["meta"]["estimated_tokens"]
                    with open(stats_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        json.dump(stats, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
                    print(f" PDF Saved! Total: {stats['total_entries']} entries, ~{stats['total_tokens_estimate']:,} tokens")
            pdf_queue.task_done()
        except queue.Empty:
            break
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"PDF worker error: {e}")
            pdf_queue.task_done()


def crawl_all_pages_parallel(start_url, max_pages=90000):
    parsed_start = urlparse(start_url)
    base_domain = parsed_start.netloc
    url_queue = queue.Queue()
    pdf_queue = queue.Queue()
    url_queue.put(start_url)
    url_threads = []
    for i in range(len(api_keys) * 30):
        t = threading.Thread(target=worker_thread, args=(url_queue, pdf_queue, base_domain, max_pages))
        t.daemon = True
        t.start()
        url_threads.append(t)
    pdf_threads = []
    for i in range(len(api_keys) * 45):
        t = threading.Thread(target=pdf_worker_thread, args=(pdf_queue,))
        t.daemon = True
        t.start()
        pdf_threads.append(t)
    url_queue.join()
    for t in url_threads:
        t.join()
    time.sleep(5)
    pdf_queue.join()
    for t in pdf_threads:
        t.join()
    return visited_urls


def main():
    print("=" * 120)
    print("ARXIV.ORG WORLD-CLASS DATASET CREATOR")
    print("TARGET: GPT-5+ QUALITY TRAINING DATA")
    print("SOURCE: devdocs.io + kapcsolódó dokumentációs oldalak")
    print("PARALLELISM: Multi-thread crawling + több Cerebras kliens")
    print("MULTI-CLIENT PARALLEL: 4x Cerebras API Keys | 120 URL Workers | 180 PDF Workers - MAXIMÁLIS SEBESSÉG!")
    print("MODELS: qwen-3-coder-480b (primary) + gpt-oss-120b (fallback) + qwen-3-32b (backup)")
    print("OUTPUT: JSONL format with quality scores and metadata")
    print("=" * 120)
    with open(output_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("")
    with open(stats_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(stats, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    start_url = ""
    all_visited = crawl_all_pages_parallel(start_url, max_pages=200000)
    print("\n" + "=" * 120)
    print("COMPLETED!")
    print(f" Pages processed: {stats['html_pages']}")
    print(f" PDFs processed: {stats['pdfs']}")
    print(f" Total entries: {stats['total_entries']}")
    print(f" Estimated tokens: ~{stats['total_tokens_estimate']:,}")
    print(f" Processing errors: {stats['processing_errors']}")
    print(f" Output: {output_file}")
    print(f" Stats: {stats_file}")
    print("=" * 120)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    if len(re.findall(r"\b[A-ZÁÉÍÓÖŐÚÜŰ][a-záéíóöőúüű]+\b", content)) > 50:
        quality_indicators += 1
    if re.search(r"\$\$[\s\S]+?\$\$", content):
        quality_indicators += 2
    if any(token in content.lower() for token in ["bevezetés", "használat", "példa", "funkció", "definíció"]):
        quality_indicators += 1
    return quality_indicators >= 4


def create_instruction_entry(cleaned_content, metadata, url, content_type):
    title = metadata.get("title", "")
    framework = metadata.get("framework", "programozási téma")
    if not title:

    instructions = [

    ]

def download_and_process_pdf(pdf_url):
    with pdf_lock:
        if pdf_url in visited_pdfs:
            return None
        visited_pdfs.add(pdf_url)
    print(f"\n[PDF DOWNLOAD] {pdf_url}")
    client_idx = get_client()
    try:
        response = requests.get(
            pdf_url,
            timeout=60,
            headers={
                "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
            }
        )
        if response.status_code != 200:
            return None
        pdf_file = io.BytesIO(response.content)
        pdf_reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(pdf_file)
        pdf_text = ""
        max_pages = min(len(pdf_reader.pages), 99)
        for page_num in range(max_pages):
            try:
                page = pdf_reader.pages[page_num]
                text = page.extract_text()
                if text:
                    pdf_text += text + "\n\n"
            except Exception:
                continue
        if len(pdf_text.strip()) <= 500:
            return None
        metadata = {
            "title": "",
            "framework": "PDF Documentation",
            "category": ""
        }
        cleaned = process_with_ultra_quality_ai(pdf_url, pdf_text, "pdf", client_idx, metadata)
        if not cleaned or not quality_check_content(cleaned):
            return None
        content_hash = calculate_content_hash(cleaned)
        with hash_lock:
            if content_hash in content_hashes:
                return None
            content_hashes.add(content_hash)
        entry = create_instruction_entry(cleaned, metadata, pdf_url, "pdf")
        return entry
    except Exception as e:
        print(f" [PDF ERROR] {e}")
        with output_lock:
            stats["processing_errors"] += 1
        return None
    finally:
        return_client(client_idx)


def get_all_links(url, base_domain):
    try:
        response = requests.get(
            url,
            timeout=3,
            headers={
                "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
            }
        )
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")
        links = set()
        pdf_links = set()
        for link in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
            href = link.get("href")
            full_url = urljoin(url, href)
            parsed = urlparse(full_url)
            if parsed.netloc == base_domain and not parsed.fragment:
                clean_url = f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}{parsed.path}"
                if parsed.query:
                    clean_url += f"?{parsed.query}"
                if clean_url.endswith(".pdf"):
                    pdf_links.add(clean_url)
                else:
                    links.add(clean_url)
        return links, pdf_links
    except Exception as e:
        print(f" Error getting links from {url}: {e}")
        return set(), set()

def worker_thread(url_queue, pdf_queue, base_domain, max_pages):
    while True:
        try:
            url = url_queue.get(timeout=3)
            with url_lock:
                if len(visited_urls) >= max_pages:
                    url_queue.task_done()
                    break
            crawl_page(url, base_domain)
            new_links, new_pdfs = get_all_links(url, base_domain)
            for link in new_links:
                with url_lock:
                    if link not in visited_urls and len(visited_urls) < max_pages:
                        url_queue.put(link)
            for pdf_link in new_pdfs:
                with pdf_lock:
                    if pdf_link not in visited_pdfs:
                        pdf_queue.put(pdf_link)
            url_queue.task_done()
        except queue.Empty:
            break
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Worker error: {e}")
            url_queue.task_done()


def pdf_worker_thread(pdf_queue):
    while True:
        try:
            pdf_url = pdf_queue.get(timeout=3)

                with output_lock:
